jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician, Electrical (English, German) (m/w/d) (Leitende/r Haustechniker/in)
jobs.description: This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.Minimum qualifications:- Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.- 2 years of experience with Electrical Distribution Systems (High Voltage, Low Voltage, Protection and Controls, Power Quality).- Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends and holidays on shift based schedules as required.- Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting and work on platforms, ladders, and under raised floors.- Ability to communicate in English and German fluently to work with colleagues.Preferred qualifications:- Experience planning and executing installation, commissioning, and equipment startup, following industry best practices and protocols.- Experience working in the control room for critical operations.- Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems in data center environments and controls/monitoring systems.- Excellent written, verbal communication and people management skills, with the ability to prioritize work efficiently.About the JobThe Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.***** Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.- Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.- Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.- Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Die Medizinische Fakultät der Universität Leipzig gehört mit ihrer über 600jährigen Tradition zu den größten Forschungseinrichtungen der Region Leipzig. Mit über 1.300 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern ist sie die größte von insgesamt 14 Fakultäten der Universität Leipzig und dient als Ausbildungsstätte für ca. 3.500 Studierende der Human- und Zahnmedizin sowie der Pharmazie und Hebammenkunde.The Institute for Drug Discovery at Leipzig University Medical School is looking for a postdoctoral researcher for a collaborative research project.On that position, the applicant will- Develop strategies for de novo design of enzymes with new-to-nature function, including unnatural enantioselectivity: create new-to-nature theozymes, analyze their scaffoldability with current generative tools, and build early "no-go" filters that discard unpromising theozymes and designs before costly computation.- Develop and stress-test tools that predict/assess substrate selectivity of designed enzymes at the scoring and filtering stage. Analyze what is currently available, test those tools and their underlying ideas critically, and build better ones.- Prepare and curate datasets, train custom machine-learning models and develop new architectures, and maintain reproducible pipelines and released code.- Work with industry and experimental partners in milestones: meet deadlines, prepare and present reports, translate target reactions into design problems, and choose designs for validation.- Publish and present results, and contribute to follow-up proposals.- Teach and supervise students.Candidate requirements- PhD in computational biology, biochemistry, computational chemistry or a related field.- Experience in computational protein or enzyme design; solid understanding of enzyme mechanisms.- Hands-on machine-learning experience: dataset preparation, training of custom models, development of new architectures.- Strong Python and Linux/HPC skills; experience with tools such as RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN, AlphaFold or Boltz.- Ability to set research directions independently, compare alternative approaches critically, and collaborate with experimental groups.- Good English and willingness to learn German.- Desirable: QM/MM, molecular dynamics or Rosetta experience.Facility: Institute Medizinische Fakultät, Insitut für Klinische PharmazieType of employment: Befristet for 1 JahrWorking hours: Vollzeit (40,00 hours)Start date: 01.12.2026Remuneration: TV-L 13- A modern workplace and attractive working conditions, including mobile working- Flexible working hours and a good work-life balance- A discounted public transport ticket (MDV JobTicket)How to ApplyPlease apply for this position through our applicant portal by 19.11.2026.Your Contact PersonFor information about the application process, please contact Anja Landsmann (T: +49 341 97 25730, E: anja.landsmann@medizin.uni-leipzig.de).Applicants with severe disabilities will be given priority consideration where they are equally qualified. Please include the relevant supporting documentation with your application.Please note that, due to legal requirements, we can only hire applicants who are immune to measles. You will be required to provide the relevant proof of immunity.
